result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal carousel content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the fixed bottom navigation obscures part of the restaurant feed.

issues.description: The category chip row ends with a partially visible, unlabeled pill at the right edge, making it look accidentally cut off.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel padding or scroll position so the next chip shows enough content to be identifiable, or hide it fully until the user scrolls.

issues.description: The third card in “Fastest near you,” including its restaurant name and delivery text, is abruptly clipped by the right viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal carousel gutters and intentional peeking width, while applying ellipsis to text within each card.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the next restaurant card, hiding a substantial portion of its image and content area.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable feed equal to the navigation bar and safe-area height so all content can scroll fully above the overlay.
